subject: EL-2: widen ask-gate predict corpus to decision/correction notes (D)
description:
Fix Mode-1 (over-escalation) of the escalate pipeline. BLOCKED BY EL-1 (shares the routes/session.js seam — sequence after it to avoid conflict). On feature branch orch/feature/escalate-liveness.

GOAL: before request_guidance files a BLOCKING text escalation, run a second recall pass over decision/correction notes (NOT just category:preference) and, on a confident 'already answered' hit, AUTO-RESOLVE the question instead of pausing the loop — returning predicted:true with the answer + provenance, the same shape the preference-predict path already returns.

WHERE: lib/ask-gate-recall.js runAskGate() currently recalls only preference notes for the predict pass. Add a parallel 'answered-downstream' check: recall top decision/correction notes (the general note pool, e.g. search_knowledge over the question text), and if a note clears a HIGH bar (reuse ask-gate.js thresholds but require strong cosine + on-task gap + project-locality — be conservative, a wrong auto-resolve silently drops a real question), resolve the escalation with that note as the answer. Wire it at the seam (routes/session.js) alongside the existing gate result: if the gate says ASK but the answered-downstream check fires, do NOT addGuidance — return the predicted answer. Journal the verdict (seam:'guidance') with a distinct reason so it is auditable, same as the existing shadow journal.

GUARDRAILS: hard-override categories (irreversible/outward/highImpact/scopeExpansion/repeatedFailure) must STILL escalate — never auto-resolve those from a note match (mirror ask-gate.js hardOverride precedence: override wins over any predict). Keep it behind the same predict-by-default discipline; default stays ASK when no confident note.

TESTS: unit test the answered-downstream predicate — a confident decision-note match auto-resolves a non-override question; a hard-override question with the same match still escalates; a diffuse match still asks.
